title: Skinny Singles
style: lo-fi indie pop, 96 BPM, dusty drum machine, warm Rhodes electric piano, mellow male vocal, hazy reverb, bedroom-pop intimacy, peaceful Sunday vibe
lyrics:
[Intro]
No partner, no problem
Skinny singles on a Sunday morning

[Verse 1]
Couldn't find a partner, couldn't find a soul
Six in the morning and the court was whole
Drew a line down the middle with my mind
Skinny singles, the lonely kind

[Verse 2]
Half the court is all I need
Half the court for half the speed
Cross-court only, down-the-line is out
Just me and the ball and the morning shout

[Chorus]
Skinny singles, skinny singles
The court is half but the joy is whole
Skinny singles, skinny singles
Only game where I am my own goal
Skinny singles

[Verse 3]
Birds got loud in the eucalyptus tree
A jogger waved like she understood me
Eleven points later I was even with myself
Put the paddle in the bag and the bag on the shelf

[Chorus]
Skinny singles, skinny singles
The court is half but the joy is whole
Skinny singles, skinny singles
Only game where I am my own goal
Skinny singles

[Bridge]
You don't have to be lonely
To play alone
Sometimes the court is the only
Way to come home

[Outro]
No partner, no problem
Skinny singles on a Sunday morning
